new_source_resolution.intercept_branches: If the inspected API semantics apply, notebook cell9 adds the population intercept to a conditional intercept that already includes it. Preserve literal notebook algebra and conditional-model algebra as separate declared branches; do not silently repair either.
new_source_resolution.variance_limit: A common population-intercept offset does not alter within-group intercept differences or variance in exact arithmetic. This source observation alone does not refute the biological variability claim.
new_source_resolution.identity_join: pd.unique(df.basef) de-duplicates numeric values and does not join coefficients by cell identity. Shared values across distinct cells and differing source row orders must be retained and checked explicitly.
new_source_resolution.support_axis: Cell4 concatenates paired and spontaneous preceding-activity arrays on the default first axis. If their axes are cell-by-trial, subsequent indexing by original cell selects the paired block. This conditional source inference is not an authenticated statement of the unreopened array shapes.

component_boundaries: Exports, cell coordinates, conditional/random fit provenance and full original cohort remain operator prerequisites.

No R/pymer4/NumPy import, fitting, authentic array/pickle loading, candidate evaluation, scientific score, primary contract mutation or readiness promotion.
